title: Senior Bookkeeper
description:
Senior Bookkeeper with Quickbooks Enterprise Experience

My name is Bill Stevens, and I have a new full time Senior Bookkeeper opportunity available for a major firm located in Pearl River, New York that could be of interest to you, please review my specification below and I am available at any time to speak with you so please feel free to call me. The forty hour work week schedule will be onsite in the firms offices.

The ideal candidate should possess a green card or be of citizenship. No Visa entanglements and no H1-B holding company submittals.

This position will be paying in the range of $90,000 - $110,000 plus a comprehensive benefits package.

The Senior Bookkeeper will be is responsible for overseeing all day-to-day bookkeeping and financial reporting functions for the organization. This role requires an expert-level proficiency in QuickBooks to maintain the integrity of the general ledger, manage complex financial records, and produce accurate and timely financial reports. The ideal candidate should possess seven to ten years of experience, the Senior Bookkeeper will be a key member of the firms finance team, assisting with strategic financial planning, training junior staff, and ensuring compliance with all accounting standards and regulations.

Responsibilities:
Manage daily financial operations: Record and post all financial transactions, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, and payroll, within QuickBooks.
Handle complex reconciliations: Lead monthly and year-end closing processes, including reconciling all bank, credit card, and general ledger accounts. Investigate and resolve any variances or discrepancies promptly.
Generate and analyze accurate financial reports, including profit & loss statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements, to support management decision-making.
Process payroll and taxes: Oversee the complete payroll process, including federal, state, and local tax filings, and the issuance of 1099s and W-2s.
Support audits: Collaborate with external auditors and accountants by providing necessary documentation and financial schedules for annual audits and tax filings.
Mentor and supervise staff: Train and provide guidance to junior bookkeeping staff. Review their work for accuracy and compliance with established procedures.
Implement process improvements: Develop and refine accounting policies and procedures to enhance the efficiency, accuracy, and security of bookkeeping operations.
Forecast and budget: Assist in the preparation of budgets and cash flow forecasts and perform variance analysis to help monitor financial performance.

Qualifications for this role:
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field preferred.
7–10 years of progressive bookkeeping or full-charge accounting experience.
Demonstrable expert-level proficiency with QuickBooks Online and Desktop.
Thorough understanding of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP).
Experience with multi-entity bookkeeping and reporting is highly desirable.
Proven ability to lead month-end and year-end closing processes independently.
Experience in managing and mentoring junior accounting staff.
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for collaborating with various departments and external partners.
Proven ability to handle sensitive and confidential financial information with integrity

The interview process will include an initial phone or virtual interview screening.

Please let me know your interest in this position, availability to interview and start for this position along with a copy of your recent resume or please feel free to call me at any time with any questions.
